new_value: Devin Fusion launched in preview June 29, 2026; Cognition claims a 35% cost cut (41% with its Fable 5 model) at frontier-level quality on its own FrontierCode benchmark.
headline: Cognition launches Devin Fusion, claims 35% lower cost at frontier quality
so_what: Cognition now has a direct answer to the cost objection and fresh proof for its model-agnostic pitch, both aimed at Cursor. Reps should expect 'Devin is 35% cheaper now' in deals and answer that the figure is a preview on Cognition's own benchmark, not a shipped price cut.

new_value: Devin Security Swarm launched July 1, 2026, available enterprise-wide on day one, with a Cognition-run benchmark citing 72% vulnerability recall versus Cursor's 26%.
headline: Cognition launches Devin Security Swarm and publishes a benchmark ranking Cursor's security scanning last.
so_what: In enterprise deals where AppSec budget is in play, expect Cognition to pitch Devin as a security-team multiplier and to cite 'Cursor 26% recall' from its own test. Reps should answer that it is a Cognition-run benchmark in an adjacent category, that Cursor's number reflects a general coding tool rather than a dedicated scanner, and that the product shipped with no customer references yet.
